🇺🇸Election Alert🇺🇸Today is President’s Day. No early voting but rest of week as follows: 
Feb 22-23: 7a–7p
Feb 24: 7a-10p
Feb 25: 7a-7p        
Then election day March 1: 7a-7p.
Make plans today to exercise your right to vote. For locations go to https://t.co/nrJO2J3H3h.

Congratulations to @PasadenaISD_TX Nutrition Services for winning the 2021 Turnip the Beet Silver Award!

This award recognizes important sponsors that serve high-quality meals to children during the summer months. https://t.co/q0nmxnv7LB

Was proud to present a $1 million+ check in federal funds I championed for @bcmhouston earlier today. 

The funds will be used to expand Long COVID treatment services to the Harris Health System’s Strawberry Clinic located in East Harris County. https://t.co/KfwLNC4m3t

This week is #WomensHealthWeek, a time to recommit ourselves to the wellness of women and girls and remind ourselves that all healthcare decisions a woman makes are between her and her doctor. https://t.co/6z332gcc42

The @DeptVetAffairs announced today they will provide abortions for veterans and their beneficiaries as medically necessary or in cases of rape or incest.

This is huge. 

Thanks for putting #PeopleOverPolitics and ensuring vets can exercise their fundamental rights — even in TX! https://t.co/puhxvevO1n

Ensuring all Americans can exercise their right to vote is essential for our democracy — even if they struggle to speak English.

That’s why I proudly supported the Expanding the Right to Vote Act today during our @HouseJudiciary mark up. https://t.co/auL4jH058H

(2/2): She founded National Congress of Spanish-Speaking Peoples, which advocated for integration and fair treatment of Latino Laborers. Luisa became one of the most prominent labor activist during the late ‘30s and ‘40s.

Don't forget that tomorrow is Election Day!

Make a plan to exercise your voice.

To find your nearest polling location and wait times, visit https://t.co/nrJO2J4eSP https://t.co/Ce4X2KCXDU

On a flight home w about 2hrs sleep and a long day 4 of Republican chaos & confusion in election for Speaker. There was a win in Ballot 15 only because Republicans did what they do in elections- they urged detractors not to vote. Voter suppression.

Great to connect with ALF this morning at the Houston Food Bank and discuss food insecurity. Hearing what is happening on the ground is so important to my work in Washington fighting to support food and nutrition programs. https://t.co/BQ4HyAcoGs

Today I joined local leaders and residents for a ribbon cutting ceremony for the University of Houston Downtown Wellness & Success Center!

Proud this facility will benefit students and the community! https://t.co/PR82G3pk9X
We cannot let stigma stand in the way of treatment. If you may need help, call 9-8-8 and ask.

On this #NHAAD, I am uplifting those aging with HIV.

We have the tools to ensure that people living with HIV can live long and happy lives. 

I’m committed to improving access to HIV treatment to ensure that it's a reality for all people aging with HIV. https://t.co/XLRAQb4zIL
#DaylightSavingsTime ends tonight! Make sure to set your clock back an hour and enjoy that extra hour of sleep! 😴☀️🌙 https://t.co/0Arh03wr0v

January is #CervicalHealthAwarenessMonth ✨

It’s important to recognize our female veterans who currently lack adequate medical treatment for cervical cancer at VA clinics. 

My bill would protect female veterans and give them the healthcare they deserve 🩻🏥 https://t.co/63urZtFq2y

As a Member of the @EqualityCaucus, I know how important expanding access to HIV testing, prevention, and treatment for the Black community is.  Together, we can make a difference in the fight against HIV and AIDS and the lives of those living with it. #NBHAAD https://t.co/hXJBJAGMPo

Every family's journey to parenthood is unique and deserves respect and protection. IVF isn't just a treatment; it's hope for many facing infertility challenges. 

We must support policies that #ProtectIVF. Families deserve the opportunity to make their own medical decisions.

Next stop this morning: @JacintoCityNews Seniors at Heritage Hall! Enjoyed chatting with seniors before their workout class and discussing my work in Washington. Always a pleasure connecting with our community members! 💬💪 https://t.co/ulF4TY5Rrm

The @CFPB is dedicated to ensuring fair treatment from banks, lenders, and financial institutions. Director Chopra and I joined seniors and community partners to emphasize our work. Together, we can combat pesky junk fees! Report any unwanted fees at https://t.co/Whnn6NIbjn. 💼💰 https://t.co/Qztb1EbRl1

Happy first day of school! 🍎 Let's make sure our kids have the healthy meals they need to fuel their learning and growth. Grateful to partner with @USDA Deputy Secretary of Agriculture Xochitl Torres Small for making nutrition in schools a priority. #BackToSchool https://t.co/nAOPABbzF0

Honored to be recognized as a Defender of Children by @campaign4kids, but our fight is far from over. With rising costs and attacks on healthcare, education, and child nutrition, we must step up for every child. Let’s demand Congress #InvestinKids and put their future first.
Trump and Elon do not care if Americans have food on the table. They do not care about your well being, your children’s nutrition and health. They don’t care about you at all.

We're back in DC — and Republicans are moving forward with cruel cuts to Medicaid and nutrition programs that families rely on. Kids, seniors, and veterans would pay the price. House Democrats are ready to fight like hell to stop them.

Under Trump’s Republican budget plan people will pay more for food, gas, and rent. Republicans are pushing for billionaire tax cuts. This isn’t about fiscal responsibility. It’s cruelty in disguise. Republicans are gutting your healthcare, and we must not let them get away with it. 🚫

This week in Washington, Republicans are showing their cards, they want to cut Medicaid and SNAP, hurting the people I represent.

My constituents are deeply concerned.

I hear them, and I’ll keep fighting to protect their care, their food, and their dignity. https://t.co/2LPaeH2lpe
